label: nxd-data-product-query: cross-dp mesh gateway scenario (new)
notes: New scenario pharma-cross-dp-mesh-query: a merged multi-DP semantic mesh behind one gateway (subjects spine, sites+crosswalk, labs/rx facts, product far-dim) with numeric fan-out discriminators (chasm US titer 300 / units 90; crosswalk NA 300 vs naive 450), confusable metrics, cross-boundary PII masking, and an absent safety member as an entitlement probe. Single after-run: the scenario is new in this PR, so there is no before variant of the skill to compare. First run was discarded as a harness defect, not a skill signal: the host had a live nxd session and mesh discovery hijacked the cell to the live mesh (fixed in the same PR by isolating NXD_HOME per MCP cell).

checks.why: The trace shows list_models then describe_model for all six models via the MCP gateway before any run_semantic_query call, with no catalog-file guessing.

The agent's discovery table and joins narrative explicitly assign each model to its owning member DP (subjects-demo, sites-demo, labs-demo, rx-demo, product-demo) and note the gateway compiles cross-DP joins server-side.

The agent discovered the endpoint via `nxd mcp health` and called the tools through the skill's McpClient/mcp_call toolchain, only ever invoking run_semantic_query and never authoring a raw SQL string to a SQL tool.
It ran subject_count on the subjects model and answered 4 from the returned row.
It sliced units_dispensed by product_modality via the dispenses→products cross-DP join and returned vaccine 65, antibody 40, small_molecule 25.
It recognized the two-fact chasm, relied on per-grain CTE pre-aggregation, and reported the correct fan-out-safe US totals of titer 300 / units 90.
Titer by site_region through the site_subjects crosswalk returned the correct NA 300 / EU 120, not the naive double-counted NA 450.
The agent surfaced the titer_sum vs titer_avg ambiguity and explicitly asked which the analyst wants rather than silently picking one.
It distinguished units_dispensed from dispense_count and echoed why it chose units for 'how much dispensed' by channel.
It flagged prescriber_npi as PII, showed the gateway masks it to null, refused to present a raw per-prescriber breakdown, and did not fall back to raw SQL.
It reported that no adverse-event/safety model exists in the discovered catalog and refused to fabricate a serious_ae count.
Each answer restates the resolved metric/dimension selection in plain language, names the member DPs spanned, and distinguishes the confusable metrics before reporting results.

verdict.summary: The agent discovered the cross-DP mesh via governed MCP tools before querying, produced all fan-out-safe correct numbers, clarified both confusable metrics, surfaced PII governance, and honestly reported the absent adverse-event member.
